title: Seacrest Beach 40 Sand Flea Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to beach and pool- Gulf Views from the third-floor primary balcony- Preferred location at the front of the neighborhood - no need for the trams- Minutes from Rosemary Beach shopping & dining- New Furnishings- Porch off every bedroom- 4 adult bikes- 3 dedicated parking spots with additional parking available throughout the community- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutPlease note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: 40 Sand Flea Drive is a spectacular Gulf-view, 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home that sleeps 8 in the laidback, family-oriented community of Seacrest Beach. Located at the front of the neighborhood, enjoy a quick walk to the nearest beach access and community pool—the largest pool on Scenic 30A! Guests will love the spacious accommodations in this home, and top-floor entertainment deck with a TV, kitchen, and more!The first-floor great room welcomes guests in with a harmonious blend of natural colors and textures, as well as pops of blue for the perfect beach aesthetic. The living room boasts new furnishings and an impressive 85" TV with a Sonos sound system. Enjoy meals in the traditional dining area, complete with a round table that seats 6. The pristine white kitchen is equipped with sleek cabinetry, plenty of counter space, and high-end appliances, including a built-in microwave drawer and an additional beverage cooler. The kitchen island doubles as a 4-stool breakfast bar and is perfect for casual dining. Retreat to the comfortable guest bedroom, which offers a king bed and direct access to the back porch.Experience luxury and comfort on the second floor of this 3-story home. The primary bedroom boasts a king bed, while the guest bedroom boasts 2 queen beds—both enjoy private bathrooms and private balconies with plush furnishings. Plus, there's a laundry room for convenience.Luxury awaits guests on the third floor of this exquisite property, with 1 guest bedroom featuring a king-sized bed and access to a private balcony with breathtaking Gulf views, as well as a wet bar down the hallway with a beverage cooler and ice maker. For entertainment, the expansive third-floor deck offers more Gulf views, a 75" TV, comfortable couches and armchairs, and an alfresco dining table that seats 10. An attached open-air kitchen features a natural gas grill, sink, and ample counter space—perfect for hosting a cookout!Vacation in style at 40 Sand Flea Drive! With on-site parking for 3 vehicles—plus 4 complimentary adult bikes—exploring the local shops, dining spots, and entertainment of Rosemary Beach is a breeze. Easily access the nearest beach via the Villas at Sunset Beach, located directly south of Seacrest Beach. Book this dream vacation home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.
